10-minutes-till-dawn.description: Survive waves of monsters in a dark arena where every upgrade changes the rhythm of the run. Build a loadout fast, keep moving, and try to last until the timer runs out.

backrooms-3d.description: Wander through eerie yellow halls and liminal rooms in a first-person Backrooms escape. Listen, navigate carefully, and look for exits before the environment gets the better of you.

bacon-may-die.description: Fight through waves of enemies as a scrappy hero with melee weapons, guns, and fast dodges. The action is silly, punchy, and built for chaotic survival runs.

big-flappy-tower-tiny-square.description: Climb a huge tower as a tiny square while flappy-style movement makes every gap risky. Precision, patience, and quick resets are the whole challenge.

big-ice-tower-tiny-square.description: Scale an icy tower packed with slippery platforms, spikes, and tight jumps. The controls are simple, but the level asks for careful movement and steady nerves.

big-neon-tower-tiny-square.description: Dash through a bright neon tower full of hazards, checkpoints, and narrow platforming routes. Each section rewards clean timing and learning from mistakes.

big-tower-tiny-square-2.description: Return to the giant tower for another round of precise square-platforming. Expect tight jumps, traps, checkpoints, and a lot of satisfying almost-there attempts.

buckshot-roulette.description: Face a tense tabletop duel built around a shotgun, limited items, and reading the odds. Each round is a risky mind game where one wrong call can end everything.

cluster-rush.description: Leap across moving trucks in a first-person platforming rush where the ground never stays still. Time your jumps, ride the chaos, and reach the finish before the convoy falls apart.

cookie-clicker.description: Click cookies, buy upgrades, and turn a single bakery into an absurd production empire. The fun comes from watching small gains snowball into ridiculous numbers.

core-ball.description: Launch numbered balls onto a rotating core without hitting the ones already attached. It is a simple timing puzzle that gets tense as the safe spaces disappear.

crazy-cattle-3d.description: Drive a cattle around a chaotic 3D arena and slam into others until only one is left standing. Use speed, angles, and physics to knock rivals out before they do the same to you.

crossy-road.description: Hop across roads, rivers, and train tracks while chasing one more step forward. The rules are instant to understand, but the timing gets dangerous fast.

drive-mad.description: Guide a vehicle across unstable obstacle courses filled with ramps, bumps, and awkward physics. The goal is simple, but keeping the car balanced is the real test.

duck-life.description: Train a duck across racing skills, earn coins, and compete in events to become a champion. The loop is part training mini-games, part gradual upgrade climb.

duck-life-2.description: Take your duck around the world and train multiple skills for tougher races. Each practice session improves your chances when the next championship begins.

duck-life-3.description: Evolve and train your duck through new skill paths before entering bigger races. It keeps the familiar training loop while adding more progression choices.

funny-shooter-2.description: Blast through waves of strange enemies in a colorful first-person shooter. Unlock weapons, keep moving, and clear arenas packed with ridiculous targets.

granny.description: Escape a locked house while a dangerous character listens for every sound you make. Search for items, solve small puzzles, and stay hidden long enough to get out.

learn-to-fly.description: Help a determined penguin launch farther with gliders, rockets, and upgrades. Each run earns money for better gear, turning tiny flights into record-breaking launches.

learn-to-fly-2.description: Upgrade your penguin's launch setup and smash through obstacles on the way to longer flights. It expands the original formula with more equipment and goals to chase.

learn-to-fly-3.description: Build rockets and launch a penguin upward instead of just across the ice. Experiment with stages, boosters, and payloads to reach higher altitudes.

motox3m.description: Race a motocross bike through stunt tracks packed with loops, spikes, and explosive hazards. Fast times require both speed and careful midair control.

motox3m-2.description: Take on more Moto X3M stunt courses with bigger hazards and tighter timing. Flip for time bonuses, land cleanly, and keep the bike moving.

motox3m-3.description: Another round of Moto X3M tracks built for fast retries and risky stunts. The best runs mix aggressive acceleration with smart braking before traps.

motox3m-spookyland.description: Ride through Halloween-themed Moto X3M levels filled with haunted hazards and stunt ramps. Keep your bike balanced while the course throws tricks at every landing.

motox3m-winter.description: Race through snowy Moto X3M stages with icy ramps, traps, and seasonal obstacles. Clean flips and controlled landings are the path to better times.

slope-3.description: Roll down a neon slope at high speed while dodging gaps, walls, and sudden turns. The longer you survive, the faster and sharper the track becomes.

snow-rider-3d.description: Ride a sled down snowy hills while dodging trees, rocks, and other obstacles. Grab gifts when you can, but survival depends on quick steering.

soccer-random.description: Play unpredictable ragdoll soccer where each round changes the field, players, or physics. Score five goals first, and expect every match to get weird in a new way.

super-hot.description: Fight through stylized combat encounters where time moves mainly when you move. Plan each step, dodge bullets, and turn split-second action into a puzzle.

the-binding-of-isaac.description: Explore randomly generated rooms in a dark roguelike shooter filled with strange items and dangerous enemies. Each run builds a different character loadout as you push deeper underground.

the-worlds-hardest-game.description: Move a small square through brutal obstacle rooms while collecting coins and reaching the goal. The challenge is pure timing, route planning, and patience.

tiny-fishing.description: Cast a line, catch fish, and upgrade your gear to reach deeper water. Each trip brings in money for better hooks, longer lines, and bigger catches.

ultrakill.description: A fast retro-styled shooter built around aggressive movement, stylish attacks, and constant momentum. Chain weapons and movement tricks to survive arenas at breakneck speed.
